content_blocks.steps_heading: Your Path to PMP Certification in Huntsville

steps_items.heading: Confirm Your Eligibility
steps_items.text: PMI requires either a four-year degree plus three years of project-management experience, or a high school diploma plus five years of experience. Review PMI's full eligibility criteria to confirm you meet the education and hours requirement before enrolling in training.

steps_items.heading: Complete 35 Hours of Formal Training
steps_items.text: Enroll in Granite PM Academy's live-virtual, instructor-led PMP Certification Training course. Attend all sessions synchronously to earn your required contact hours. Our flexible schedule accommodates Huntsville professionals balancing work and study.

steps_items.heading: Submit Your PMI Application
steps_items.text: After completing your formal education, submit your PMP application directly to PMI through their online portal. Include your training certificate from Granite PM Academy and pay the examination fee. PMI will review and approve your eligibility before you can schedule your exam.

steps_items.heading: Prepare and Pass Your Exam
steps_items.text: Use Granite PM Academy's exam-preparation resources, including practice tests and review sessions, to strengthen your knowledge. Schedule your exam through Pearson VUE. Pass the computer-based exam to earn your PMP credential and advance your career in Huntsville's defense, aerospace, and technology sectors.

steps_items.heading: Maintain Your PMP Credential
steps_items.text: Earn 60 professional development units (PDUs) over each three-year renewal cycle to keep your credential active. PDUs can be earned through formal training, self-study, volunteer work, and industry involvement. Renew by the deadline to avoid credential lapse.

fq_items.question: Do I need to travel to {city} for this training?

fq_items.question: What are the PMP eligibility requirements?
fq_items.answer: PMI sets four eligibility paths based on education: a secondary diploma (high school or equivalent) requires 60 months of project leadership experience; an associate's degree requires 48 months; a bachelor's degree requires 36 months; and a bachelor's or postgraduate degree from a PMI Global Accreditation Center (GAC)-accredited program requires just 24 months. Every path also requires 35 hours of project management education — our course satisfies this requirement in full.

fq_items.question: How long does it take to get PMP certified in {city}?
fq_items.answer: After completing training, PMI typically approves applications within 5–10 business days. Once approved, you have one year to sit for the exam. Most students study 4–8 weeks after the course before scheduling their exam.
